items.checks: Finite coefficient functions are converted exactly to Finsupp; W and coordinate span are actual ranges. New directionEquiv is a genuine linear equivalence, solution_is_translate/fiber_is_translate identify actual assignment-space translates. Their finranks prove affine dimensions. Full coordinate_image condition proves both necessity and sufficiency.

Nat.card counts follow actual quotient-dual parametrizations of solutions/fibres, then a total-space image×fibre bijection. Positive finite field cardinality justifies cancellation; finite-dimensional rank inequalities justify natural-number subtractions. Empty coordinate sets retained.

Each row has actual finite support, hence continuous evaluation on arbitrary products. Closed solution subset of finite discrete-field product is compact and totally disconnected. Nonemptiness follows proved algebraic extension, an allowed alternative to FIP. finite_joint_iff uses actual augmented rows with finite row/coordinate sets simultaneously.

Finite solvability yields ker(rowMap)≤ker(constants) by support of arbitrary relation. Actual functional extension gives global assignment and explicit quotient-dual parametrization. All coordinates and all nonempty fibres use original domains, with no finite-dimensional or topological restriction.

For every finite set, the finite sum of single-coordinate vectors solves x_i=1. Any putative global finitely supported vector has a missing index, contradicting 1≠0. Full assignment versus finite support is preserved.

Image is an intersection over finite-support row/coordinate relations of actual finite-coordinate closed equations. Algebraic sufficiency is proved for any field; no compactness assumption or closed-map argument over infinite fields.
